summary: Monolithic Power Systems filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 annual meeting voting results and declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $2.00 per share. The dividend will be paid on July 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine capital return event with no premium, merger, or activist involvement. The company is returning capital to shareholders in the ordinary course. No special situation or extraordinary corporate event is present. Watch for any future changes in dividend policy or special dividends.
